title: The Great Barrier Reef isn’t dead yet. According to News Corp that makes climate science a ‘pseudo-religion’ | Temperature Check

paragraphs.en: The Australian newspaper appeared to think it had a slam-dunk this week with a front page story pointing to official government data which showed “the Great Barrier Reef is refusing to die” despite decades of warnings that global heating would cause its demise .
paragraphs.zh: 本周，《澳大利亚人报》似乎认为自己抓到了一个“十拿九稳”的话题：一篇头版报道援引官方政府数据称，“大堡礁拒绝死亡”，尽管数十年来一直有人警告全球变暖将导致其毁灭。

paragraphs.en: In an editorial to back its reporting, the newspaper claimed the “continued good health” of the reef was a “welcome reminder that physics rather than the pseudo-religion of climate change doom still holds sway over the natural order.”
paragraphs.zh: 在一篇为其报道撑腰的社论中，该报声称，大堡礁“持续保持健康”，是“一个令人欣慰的提醒：在自然秩序中起支配作用的仍是物理学，而非‘气候变化末日论’这一伪宗教”。

paragraphs.en: Scientific-based assessments of risks facing the reef from global heating were wrong, it seemed, and the data and the physics showed it.
paragraphs.zh: 看起来，基于科学的风险评估认为全球变暖对大堡礁构成威胁，这种评估是错的，数据和物理定律证明了这一点。

paragraphs.en: But the Australian Institute of Marine Science – the agency upon which the outlet pinned its claims – has told this column the newspaper was guilty of “oversimplified framing” and that its recent surveys did not contradict warnings about the risks to the reef from the climate crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 但澳大利亚海洋科学研究所——这家机构是该报据以作出上述论断的依据——已告诉本专栏，该报存在“过度简化的表述”之嫌，其近期的调查并未与有关气候危机对大堡礁构成风险的警告相矛盾。

paragraphs.en: “The scientific concern is not that the GBR should already have disappeared, it’s whether reefs will have sufficiently long periods between disturbances for full ecosystem recovery,” the institute said.
paragraphs.zh: “科学界担心的并不是大堡礁本应已经消失，而是珊瑚礁能否在两次干扰之间获得足够长的间隔期，以实现生态系统的完全恢复。”该研究所表示。

paragraphs.en: The Guardian sent questions to The Australian but received no response.
paragraphs.zh: 《卫报》向《澳大利亚人报》发送了提问，但没有收到回复。

paragraphs.en: The Australian’s report leaned heavily on the latest annual results of the institute’s long-term monitoring program – a 40-year effort which, between August 2025 and June 2026, took detailed records from surveys of 121 reefs.
paragraphs.zh: 《澳大利亚人报》的报道严重依赖该研究所长期监测项目的最新年度结果。这一项目已持续40年，在2025年8月至2026年6月期间，通过对121座珊瑚礁的调查取得了详细记录。

paragraphs.en: The program reports annually on levels of coral cover – that is, how much live hard coral is growing on reef areas – which was at “near record levels” across the reef, The Australian reported.
paragraphs.zh: 该项目每年报告珊瑚覆盖水平——即珊瑚礁区域上活体硬珊瑚的生长量——据《澳大利亚人报》报道，大堡礁的珊瑚覆盖水平已达到“接近创纪录的水平”。
